_about: ONE shared layout for the unit (OpenPocket #364). Read by cad/layout.py (every part, assembly, render and GLB script) and by control-ui/src/layout.ts (the sim). mm, Z up, tank floor at z = 0. Anything marked ASSUMED is not given by the owner.

_notes.water_level_mm: owner: normal water level about 15 cm above the tank floor
_notes.cart_below_track_mm: MEASURED from the CAD: the cart (plate, battery, sampler coil, silicone link, parking socket) reaches 165 mm past the track axis on the lid side when the top sleeve is closed on the track (parking socket x 105 vs track axis x -60 in cart_assembly.py). water_assembly.check() recomputes it and fails if the real cart is deeper than this number.
_notes.cart_clearance_mm: ASSUMED: 110 mm of air between the lowest cart part and the tank lid, so the bottom run is 275 mm over the lid (165 + 110). Was 45 (track 210 over the lid). OpenPocket #461: the pod-grab cart now hangs UNDER the track on its top sleeve, which puts the arm base 60 mm lower over the lid than when it rode on the bottom sleeve; with 45 mm the arm cannot reach tray rows B to D. 110 is the smallest value (tried 45, 65, 85, 105: rows B to D unreachable; 110, 115, 120, 125: whole tray reachable) that lets it carry a pod to every tray cell; the sim has no offset of its own any more.
